description: The Linux E2E matrix of .github/workflows/ci-linux.yml (job e2e-linux). Every step of the former single job is listed exactly once: shared steps run in every row, every other step in the one row that lists it. subjects are the evidence subjects each row records; prerequisites are steps whose effect (an installed package, a loaded module, an exported environment) a later step consumes, so both must stay in the same row and in this order.
